proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_summoned_companion_family
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core mechanic is a reusable summoned companion with deterministic summon, control, initiative, duration, dismissal, and cooldown semantics, but MagicItemMechanics cannot carry spawned-creature payloads.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action to summon a Fire Elemental.

proposed_widenings.name: activation_proximity_condition
proposed_widenings.justification: Activated magic items currently gate activation only by equipment predicates. This item requires a spatial proximity gate to the item itself.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you are within 5 feet of this brazier

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall because any current magic-item encoding would be misleading. The summon/companion payload exists only for spell families, and the item also needs a proximity-based activation gate.
